premises.text: Combining strong plush-toy demand with growing online custom-design habits creates a unique custom plush offering
premises.evidence_span: We're combining these two trends to create something truly cool and unique for our customers

premises.text: An online toy designer lets users change colors, body parts, decorations, and names
premises.evidence_span: They can change the colors, they can change the body parts, they can change the decorations, they can write their name on it

premises.text: After design, the company physically manufactures and ships the custom plush
premises.evidence_span: we actually manufacture the toy, physically manufacture the toy and send it to you

premises.text: Initial launch targets individuals; later iterations target small businesses and organizations
premises.evidence_span: Our initial website launch is targeted mostly at individuals

value.text: Users create cool, cute, and crazy custom plush toys online that are uniquely theirs
value.evidence_span: give users the ability to create cool, cute, and crazy custom plush toys online

causal_links.evidence_span: create their truly own personal and unique toy

notes: Q&A pricing excluded (§4.2.5). Market $1.7B and CafePress analogies treated as framing/evidence for P1, not separate premises. Factory video is illustration of P3.
